title: Snooze for calibration during night
body: Is it possible to add an option to snooze or disable the calibration reminders just during night? So you would not have to enable and disable it every day again...

comments.body:
Do you have your phone plugged in charging at night? There is the option in `Calibration Alerts` which says `Even when charging` if you un-check this option then it wont prompt for calibration while plugged in charging. 

If you don't see that option, please switch to the nightly update channel.
Ok, thanks! Found the option! Great!

How about if the phone is not charging at night? I still disable calibration alerts every night because that is not when I charge the phone.
Thanks
